name: Backboard Breakout
description: Smash every panel on the orange backboard with the ball: read the rebounds, follow up, keep the ball alive. Clear the board and a fresh one appears. No clock; the ball and your car never reset.
notes: Panels from a surface grid on orange_backboard (easy 3x2, medium 4x2, hard 5x3). Live play: chain keeping car and ball, also after goals.
